Sophie: Quick AM check-in — what I did / blockers / today
- Yesterday: finished NovaHealth RFP answers, sent initial security questionnaire.
- Blocker: waiting on security for BYOK confirmation and SOC2 excerpt from their side. @Jamal (Security) can you advise?
- Today: follow up with eng on on‑prem integration timeline + prep demo notes.

Jordan: Noted. Two asks from NovaHealth: 1) BYOK flow details; 2) latency SLA (p95/p99) for Dedicated pilot. Can we get numbers or a short profile?

Jamal (Security): Saw the questionnaire. We need the customer's SOC2 link and the key management flow doc from eng to validate BYOK. ETA for our review: EOD today. If eng can provide keywrap.md or a short diagram that helps.

Alex (Platform): I’ll put the keywrap flow into a gist and post in #eng-platform by 12:00 PT. For Dedicated pilot latency: our recent run (q4-config) shows p95 ~350ms, p99 ~520ms for 1k req/min burst; can run a 60m profiling job if they want exact numbers for their expected seq lengths.

Maria (Sales Ops): :thumbsup: Thanks team. If security signs off today we can lock the demo for Thurs AM. We’re holding pricing until BYOK is confirmed — customer flagged it as mandatory.

deploy-bot: demo env created: https://redwood.dev/demo/novahealth — access controlled, creds via 1Password shared folder.

Jamal (Security): Ack — will confirm after we review eng doc. Sophie, can you DM me the SOC2 link?

Sophie: Sent SOC2 link to @Jamal and pasted gist when Alex posts. Will update the thread with timing for Thurs demo once we have confirmation.
